# Imagineers.ai

> Imagineers.ai is a South African firm that runs AI executive training, provides fractional CAiO (Chief AI Officer) services, and delivers forward-deployed AI engineering (FDE). Founded by Rutger-Jan van Spaandonk and Chris Barker.

Imagineers.ai has trained 725+ senior executives across 45 two-day courses in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, delivered as the Daily Maverick Executive AI Masterclass. The same team runs fractional Chief AI Officer mandates and forward-deployed engineering, embedding engineers inside client businesses to ship working AI systems against real problems.

## Pages

- [GenAI Executive Masterclass](https://www.imagineers.ai/): Two-day AI executive training for senior leaders in South Africa. R21,500 incl VAT per person, open enrolment in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban, or private cohorts delivered internationally on request.
- [GenAI Executive Masterclass: the full two-day programme](https://www.imagineers.ai/masterclass.html): The complete masterclass curriculum in full, module by module, including all twelve applied use cases, plus where each open enrolment cohort runs in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban. Same course as the homepage describes, at greater length.
- [Fractional CAiO as a Service](https://www.imagineers.ai/caio.html): Chief AI Officer capability without a full-time hire. Board-level credibility, operating experience at national scale, and 6,500+ hours each of hands-on frontier AI, retained as a standing mandate.
- [Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE)](https://www.imagineers.ai/fde.html): Engineers embedded inside a client's business, on their own data, shipping working AI systems against the real problem from week one. South Africa, and internationally on request.

## Explainers

- [What is a fractional CAiO?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-a-fractional-caio.html): Definition of the fractional CAiO role, what it does day to day, and how it compares to a full-time Chief AI Officer and to a traditional consultant.
- [What is a forward deployed engineer?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-a-forward-deployed-engineer.html): Definition of the forward deployed engineer (FDE) role, what it does day to day, and how it compares to a traditional consultant and a regular software engineer.
- [What is context rot?](https://www.imagineers.ai/what-is-context-rot.html): Definition of context rot, why the facts survive but the relationships between them break, how fast accuracy degrades on the MRCR-8 benchmark despite large context windows, the seven ways context breaks, and the filing habits that prevent it.
- [AI pipelines vs agents](https://www.imagineers.ai/ai-pipelines-vs-agents.html): The difference between a designed AI pipeline and an autonomous agent, why almost everything that pays commercially today is a pipeline, and where agents genuinely fit.
